name: Blood of Morphaz
label: Quest
description: Blood of Morphaz: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now the last part, the second cure.
The green drake Morphaz is known to be immune to all forms of poison and disease -- many druids died to bring us this information. There is no doubt his blood is potent for our needs.

A courier from the Cenarion Circle will take the parts you have already collected while you gather the last. Summon your allies and seek out the drake's lair in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar. Bring his blood to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the blood of Morphaz?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have slain Morphaz and carried his blood to us... I can hardly believe this good news!
We will combine the ingredients at once and begin healing the trees and creatures of Felwood. It will take a lifetime to undo what has happened here, but you have given us the means to do it.
